player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ Ɔkyeame {player_id} ({piece}). Ɔkɔtɔni ne ({opp}).
San kɔso tɛɛ '[a2 a3]' (firi → kɔ).
- Kɔsɔ a ɛyɛ pɛ a ɛkɔ anim a ɛkɔ kɔla a ɛnyɛ hɔ ma ɛbɛn hɔ.
- Atɛkyɛ a ɛyɛ kɔ a ɛkɔ so kyɛfa a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ gu so ma ɔkɔ kɔla a ɛnyɛ hɔ a ɛwɔ ɔkɔso no akyi.
Bibinii biara a wɔtɛkyɛ no ma {score_per_capture} po.
Agɔde no awieɛ ansa na {max_moves} kɔso awie anaa ansa na ɔkyeame biara nni kyɛfa a ɛfɛ.

invalid_move.bad_format: Nhyehyɛe bɔne. Fa '[a2 a3]' di dwuma.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Ɛnyɛ w'adwuma ne sɛ wobɛkyerɛ baabi a efi.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Baabi a wɔrekɔ no nyɛ kwa.

outcome.higher_score: Wɔanya nnwom a wɔkyere no pii.
